mechanism: Trazodone's alpha-adrenergic blocking properties and potential effects on potassium handling combined with exogenous potassium supplementation may increase hyperkalemia risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment or those on concurrent medications affecting potassium balance.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels periodically, particularly in patients with renal dysfunction or taking other potassium-elevating agents; adjust potassium supplementation dosage based on clinical assessment and laboratory values.
